rec: Mind Altar or Lassar teleport tablet or spell
rewards: 5000 exp lamp and 5 kudos from Historian Minas

st.t: Talk to Elias White in the Jolly Boar Inn north-east of Varrock.
Inspect the plant north of the pub.
Inspect the small rocks to the west.
Follow the path to the south and inspect the plant south west of the Jolly Boar Inn.
Continue south-east of the Saradomin statue, and inspect the bush there.
Search the bush next to the gate to the east, by the gate to Silvarea.
Inspect the small bush further to the east.
Enter the trapdoor to the north, near to the wilderness ditch.
Talk to Elias in the dungeon.
Look over the balcony to the north.
Run west and pick up the 3 bottles on the ground. You need 3 free inventory spaces.
Kill armoured zombies and fill the 3 bottles with the clouds they leave behind.
Tap the red mist each zombie leaves behind to fill a bottle. Stop when all 3 bottles are full.
Go through the west gate, next to where you picked up the bottles, and finish the cutscene with Arrav. If you skip it, try re-entering the gate.
If you have no bottles left, go back and pick up 3 where you found the first ones.
Head north along the corridor. Kill 3 armoured zombies and fill your bottles with the red mist they leave behind.
Open the gate to the east.
Look over the balcony facing over the zombie army.
Report back to Elias White in Varrock Palace, just outside Sir Prysin's room in the south-west of the palace.
Talk to Captain Rovin in Varrock Castle: go two flights up the north-west stairs.
Enter Camdozaal, west of Ice Mountain.
Talk to Ramarno to the north by the sacred forge.
s: I need your help with a shield.

st.t: Mine the barronite rocks just west of the forge until you get a barronite deposit. Barronite shards don't count.
Kill chaos golems in the eastern cavern for a chaos core.
Use a chaos core on a barronite deposit.
Use the imbued barronite on the sacred forge.

i: Mind Altar or Lassar teleport tablet or spell

st.t: Talk to Captain Rovin in Varrock Castle: go two flights up the north-west stairs.
Talk to Reldo in the Varrock Castle library.
Search the scrolls in the north-east of the library.
Read the list of elders.
Read the Varrock Census.

Talk to the descendants in the next steps one at a time and finish each chat. King Roald is never the right one, so you can skip him. As soon as someone says their family married into the Fitzharmons, skip the rest and go to Dimintheis.
Talk to Aeonisig Raispher next to King Roald.
Talk to Sir Prysin in the south west corner of Varrock Castle.
Talk to Romeo in Varrock Square.
Talk to Horvik north-east of Varrock Square.
s: I need your help with a shield.

st.t: Talk to Curator Haig in the Varrock Museum.
s: I need your help with the zombie invasion.

st.t: Talk to Dimintheis in the south-east of Varrock.
s: I need your help with the zombie invasion.

st.t: Talk to Captain Rovin in Varrock Castle, two flights up the north-west stairs, to finish the quest.
